reference: User-approved night and daylight library mockups, 2026-10-25

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production website BACKGROUND ART extracted/reconstructed from the reference mockup. Render ONLY the illustrated library interior that lies behind the interface. Remove ALL web UI, navigation, game covers, cards, text, buttons, title, menus, logos, symbols and foreground display shelf ledges; reconstruct the architecture they obscured. Full-bleed landscape 3:2 or 16:10 composition, straight-on, rich painterly high-detail fantasy archive matching the reference. Tall carved wooden bookcases full of leather books, arched window at far left, brass astrolabe on left desk, brass lamps, ladder at right, small globes, comfortable archival atmosphere. Left-center and center should stay visually calm with darker distant shelving, with ornate architecture mainly near side edges. NO giant central furniture blocking web content. At upper right a small plain deep navy fabric hanging banner is allowed but absolutely NO emblem or writing; the real site will overlay its own vector mark. Preserve fine illustrated relief/material craftsmanship like the approved gold achievement shields. This is environment artwork ONLY: absolutely NO typography, game artwork, interface, watermark, or brand mark. Night palette: dark walnut, warm amber reading lamps, golden illuminated books, deep warm brown and charcoal shadows. Readable environmental silhouettes, not pitch black. The whole scene matches the atmospheric night mockup.
